مَنْأَجٌ [A place where a wind blows with a swift course and with a sound]. Ex. “وَتُنْأَجُ الرُّكْبَانُ كُلَّ مَنْأَجِ
بِهِ نَئِيجُ كُلِّ رِيحٍ سَيْهَجِ
” (S.) ―
-b2- [A place where birds of the kind called هَام utter their cries]. Ex. “مَنْأَجَا ↓ وَٱتَّخَذَتْهُ النَّائِجَاتُ
” (TA [but quoted in the S as an ex. of منأج in the former sense].)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
